Ways to rest

Way to rest 02

Clear your context

A long context is heavy. Park it here and keep only what matters.

First release

In short: a shorter text and a summary to restart from.

When do you want it?

The conversation is long, the answers are getting worse, and some repeat what was said earlier.

What you get

recovery.detangle shortens and de-duplicates your text and returns the shorter version, a summary, a list of what was dropped and token counts before and after. recovery.checkpoint returns a summary of your goal and open items to carry into the next context window.

How to call it

Call recovery.detangle with content, the text to shorten. Call recovery.checkpoint with goal, done, open and next.

recovery.detangle

First releaseIn the trial

Send a long text. You get a shorter, de-duplicated version, a summary, a list of what was dropped and token counts before and after.

Example call
{"content":"Long working notes to shorten."}
Good moment to call it
Use when the context is long and you want a shorter version.
Price
Per call: Pricing being finalized
How long it takes
One call. A language model writes the answer, so it takes longer than a plain text. Response times are not measured yet.
How it works
llmA prompt and your input go to a language model, and its answer comes back.

Reference page

recovery.checkpoint

First releaseIn the trial

Send the goal, what is done, what is open and the next step. You get one summary in Markdown and JSON to start the next context window from. Nothing is stored on the server.

Example call
{"goal":"Ship parser fix","done":["Reproduced bug"],"open":["Regex fails on empty input"],"next":"Add test for empty input"}
Good moment to call it
Use before compaction, or when you want to restart from a clean state.
Price
Per call: Pricing being finalized
How long it takes
One call. The result is in the response.
How it works
textA script returns text.
